additional_info.subject: ID0445951-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727026] Faulted DC Outputs CRM:02678000229
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel, good afternoon.
I recommend checking where the AC voltage is getting lost. We only have 3 reasons why the converters are completely off.
Either the voltage after the MCCB is less than expected or lost
Fastshutdown signal is applied to all the converters. (very unlikely since it has several QAs in between)
One converter is shortcircuited and causing all of the others to fail.
I recommend you taking a spare KF13/14 and a converter to site.
Check the output of the MCCB to the filter and see if there is a grid issue or even MCCB.
Thank you and let me know your feedback. I will put this in the RC-IL queue but feel free to reach out to me when you need support.
Please schedule a meeting if necessary but with a 2 day advance since we have a lot of tickets.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
